handoffs.message: Helper-claimed by Claude while Codex2 completes higher-priority work.

Implementation complete. read_store methods (list_loop_runs, get_loop_run, list_sentinel_findings, get_sentinel_finding) derive from incidents dataset with pattern-ID fallback. All v5 routes wired: loop-runs, sentinel/findings, control-room composition, persona-health, strategy-health. Degraded behavior when source absent. Commit 0a09905a. 56 tests passed (12 unit + 15 v5 contract + 29 regression, 0 failures).

Review not approved: fallback/runtime source metadata is inconsistent. When PANTHEON_BFF_LOOP_RUN_STORE is populated and incidents are absent, GET /bff/v5/loop-runs and /bff/v5/loop-runs/{id} return data but meta.surfaces reports status=unavailable source=missing because the BFF still asks dataset_source('incidents') instead of the actual loop_runs fallback source; apply the same fix for sentinel_findings. Also, when an incidents source exists but is empty, list_loop_runs/list_sentinel_findings return (False, []) while detail lookup returns (True, None), so healthy empty runtime sources are misreported as missing/degraded. Existing suites pass: 27 focused loop/sentinel tests and 53 regression tests. Please fix source-aware metadata/availability and add regressions for dedicated fallback store with data and empty incidents source.

Source-aware metadata fixes committed. (1) list_loop_runs/list_sentinel_findings: changed 'if avail_inc and incidents:' to 'if avail_inc:' — empty incidents source now returns (True, []) instead of misreporting (False, []). (2) All 5 loop-runs/sentinel paths in main.py (list, detail x2, control-room): now compute src_dataset='loop_runs'/'sentinel_findings' when incidents is missing but dedicated store provides data, so meta.surfaces correctly reflects the actual source. 5 regressions added: test_read_store_loop_sentinel.py 14 passed; test_bff_v5_loop_sentinel_contract.py 18 passed; regression suite 55 passed. 0 failures.

Review approved after source-aware metadata follow-up. Reviewer patch keeps control-room loop/sentinel surfaces independent for partial dedicated fallback; verification: py_compile main/read_store, read-store suite 14 passed, v5 loop/sentinel contract 19 passed, final wiring regression group 55 passed with 14 pre-existing warnings. Owner Claude2 should create the task-scoped closeout commit and run done.
